title: 🤖 Reddit Posting Automation for AI Agent
description:
Need working Reddit posting solution for my AI agent (Agent Zero framework).

## Problem
- Current Reddit skill can only READ (fetch posts, comments)
- Cannot POST (submit posts, comments)
- Reddit API requires OAuth2 app credentials
- Browser automation fails due to CAPTCHA

## What I Need

Working Python solution that can:
1. Submit text posts to any subreddit
2. Post comments on existing posts
3. Handle authentication reliably

## Deliverables

- Working Python script using PRAW or alternative
- Setup instructions for Reddit API credentials
- Test post submitted successfully
- Packaged as Agent Zero skill (SKILL.md format) - bonus

## Requirements

- Must actually work (tested with real post)
- Clean, documented code
- Handle errors gracefully

## Skills Needed

- python
- automation
- api-integration

## Budget

8 WAGE
